name: Spider mites
description: Tiny mites thriving in hot dry weather
signs: Stippled/bronzed leaves, fine webbing on undersides
treatments: Water spray, neem or horticultural oil, miticide; treat early
source: AgriLife Vegetable Garden Insects field guide

name: Aphids
description: Soft-bodied sap suckers on new growth
treatments: Water spray, insecticidal soap, beneficial insects

name: Leaf-footed bugs
description: Large true bugs feeding on fruit
signs: Sunken discolored spots on tomatoes; clusters of nymphs
treatments: Hand-pick, row cover, pyrethrin as last resort

name: Squash vine borer
description: Moth larvae bore into squash stems
signs: Sudden vine wilt, sawdust-like frass at stem base
treatments: Row cover until flowering, stem wrap, Bt injection, remove larvae, plant moschata types

name: Squash bugs
signs: Yellow then brown leaf patches, bronze egg clusters under leaves
treatments: Hand-pick eggs, boards as traps, insecticidal soap on nymphs

name: Cucumber beetles
treatments: Row cover, yellow sticky traps, kaolin clay

name: Early blight
signs: Concentric target-spot lesions on lower leaves
treatments: Remove lower leaves, mulch, rotate, copper/chlorothalonil

name: Powdery mildew
description: Fungal disease favored by warm days/cool nights
signs: White powder on leaves, esp. cucurbits

name: Root-knot nematodes
signs: Stunting, wilting in heat, galled roots
treatments: Rotate away from Solanaceae/cucurbits, resistant (N) varieties, solarize

name: Curly top virus
treatments: Remove infected plants, shade/row cover to deter leafhoppers

name: Tomato spotted wilt virus
treatments: Remove infected plants, control thrips, resistant varieties

name: Blossom end rot
description: Calcium uptake disorder from uneven watering
signs: Sunken black patch on fruit bottom

name: Heat blossom drop
treatments: Shade cloth 30-50%, heat-set varieties, wait for cooler nights
